key_insight: A DSL-guided multi-agent LLM framework can translate natural-language materials rules into symbolic predicates, helping inverse-design agents reason more reliably for double perovskite oxide discovery.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical path to data-efficient, interpretable materials design workflows that can screen candidates and refine rules without task-specific model training.
method: Translate design rules into chemistry DSL predicates
Use accumulated materials data to test and validate rules during the design loop
Run multi-agent inverse design in ORCHESTRA for multi-objective perovskite oxide search
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that DSL-guided symbolic predicates helped identify unsupported rules, validate new rules, and improved design performance versus natural-language-only reasoning, especially for harder target properties.
watch_item: Performance gains depend on the quality of the rule DSL and available materials data, so weak or biased priors could still steer the agent toward unsupported designs.
paper_title: Symbolic Predicate-Guided Language Agents for Inverse Design of Perovskite Oxides
